purpose: Mandatory robustness evidence before promoting synthetic-stock discovery signals
selection: all priced trades; no selection by returns or parity gap
data: Massive raw and split-adjusted daily stock closes
normalization: option P&L per actual entry stock notional
movements: actual close-to-close stock returns, absolute moves and plus/minus 5% tails
exclusions: missing actual entry or exit close; adjustment-factor range exceeding 0.5% during holding period
limitations: not total return; equity dividends, option assignment, financing and executable spreads remain unmodeled
interpretation: robustness evidence, not a fresh independent out-of-sample experiment
